/**
 * Onboarding domain types. Fully self-contained: the web-cloud refactor is
 * mid-flight in src/ui/data and src/ui/runtime, so nothing here imports from
 * the app — persistence and connector/roster data arrive through the ports
 * below and get wired to the real cloud client in a later round.
 */

export type CompanySize =
  | "only-me"
  | "under-20"
  | "20-99"
  | "100-499"
  | "500-999"
  | "1000-plus"
  | "not-for-work"

export type Role =
  | "product-design"
  | "support"
  | "it"
  | "marketing"
  | "executive-owner"
  | "sales"
  | "engineering"
  | "other"

export type ReferralSource =
  | "youtube"
  | "social"
  | "ai"
  | "google"
  | "linkedin"
  | "word-of-mouth"
  | "event"
  | "podcast"
  | "other"

export type ComfortSkill = "javascript" | "sql" | "api-auth" | "regex" | "webhooks" | "none"

/** The typed object the survey collects. Persisted via OnboardingPersistence. */
export interface OnboardingAnswers {
  readonly companySize: CompanySize | null
  readonly role: Role | null
  readonly referralSource: ReferralSource | null
  readonly knowsAutomationGoal: boolean | null
  /** Free-text follow-up, only present when knowsAutomationGoal is true. */
  readonly automationGoal: string
  readonly comfortSkills: ReadonlyArray<ComfortSkill>
}

export const emptyAnswers: OnboardingAnswers = {
  companySize: null,
  role: null,
  referralSource: null,
  knowsAutomationGoal: null,
  automationGoal: "",
  comfortSkills: []
}

/**
 * Persistence port for survey answers. TODO(cloud-api): POST
 * /api/onboarding/answers — see persistence.ts for the client factory; the
 * onboarding flow wires the real cloud base URL in a later round.
 */
export interface OnboardingPersistence {
  readonly save: (answers: OnboardingAnswers) => Promise<void>
}

/** A connector offered in the multi-select picker (TODO(cloud-api): GET /api/connectors). */
export interface ConnectorInfo {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly description: string
  /** Short glyph shown in the connector tile (emoji-free; one or two letters or a symbol). */
  readonly glyph: string
  readonly readOnly: boolean
  /** Setup flow name, run during workspace setup — e.g. "slack-setup" for /slack-setup. */
  readonly setupFlow: string
}

/** Provider port for the connector picker — props-injected, never hard-coded into the component. */
export interface ConnectorProvider {
  readonly list: () => Promise<ReadonlyArray<ConnectorInfo>>
}

/** A specialist agent on the concierge's roster (TODO(cloud-api): GET /api/agents/roster). */
export interface AgentRosterEntry {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly glyph: string
  readonly oneLiner: string
}

import type { AgentRosterEntry, ComfortSkill, ConnectorInfo } from "./types.ts"

export interface SurveyOption<T extends string = string> {
  readonly id: T
  readonly label: string
  /** Exclusive options (e.g. "None of the above") clear every other selection. */
  readonly exclusive?: boolean
}

export type StepKind = "single" | "multi" | "text"

export interface SurveyStep {
  readonly id: string
  readonly kind: StepKind
  readonly title: string
  readonly hint: string | null
  readonly required: boolean
  readonly options: ReadonlyArray<SurveyOption>
  readonly confirmLabel: string
  readonly placeholder: string | null
}

/**
 * The five survey questions, in order. `automation-goal` is a conditional
 * text step inserted after `knows-goal` when the user answers "Yes" — the
 * machine computes the active step list from current answers.
 */
export const surveySteps: ReadonlyArray<SurveyStep> = [
  {
    id: "company-size",
    kind: "single",
    title: "What is the size of your company?",
    hint: null,
    required: true,
    confirmLabel: "OK",
    placeholder: null,
    options: [
      { id: "only-me", label: "Only me" },
      { id: "under-20", label: "Fewer than 20" },
      { id: "20-99", label: "20–99" },
      { id: "100-499", label: "100–499" },
      { id: "500-999", label: "500–999" },
      { id: "1000-plus", label: "1000+" },
      { id: "not-for-work", label: "I'm not using this for work" }
    ]
  },
  {
    id: "role",
    kind: "single",
    title: "What best describes your role?",
    hint: null,
    required: true,
    confirmLabel: "OK",
    placeholder: null,
    options: [
      { id: "product-design", label: "Product & Design" },
      { id: "support", label: "Support" },
      { id: "it", label: "IT" },
      { id: "marketing", label: "Marketing" },
      { id: "executive-owner", label: "Executive / Owner" },
      { id: "sales", label: "Sales" },
      { id: "engineering", label: "Engineering" },
      { id: "other", label: "Other" }
    ]
  },
  {
    id: "referral",
    kind: "single",
    title: "How did you hear about us?",
    hint: null,
    required: true,
    confirmLabel: "OK",
    placeholder: null,
    options: [
      { id: "youtube", label: "YouTube" },
      { id: "social", label: "Social media" },
      { id: "ai", label: "AI (ChatGPT, Claude…)" },
      { id: "google", label: "Google" },
      { id: "linkedin", label: "LinkedIn" },
      { id: "word-of-mouth", label: "Friend / word of mouth" },
      { id: "event", label: "Event" },
      { id: "podcast", label: "Podcast" },
      { id: "other", label: "Other" }
    ]
  },
  {
    id: "knows-goal",
    kind: "single",
    title: "Do you already know what you want to automate?",
    hint: null,
    required: true,
    confirmLabel: "OK",
    placeholder: null,
    options: [
      { id: "yes", label: "Yes" },
      { id: "not-yet", label: "Not yet" }
    ]
  },
  {
    id: "automation-goal",
    kind: "text",
    title: "What do you want to automate?",
    hint: "A sentence is plenty — this shapes what we recommend first.",
    required: true,
    confirmLabel: "OK",
    placeholder: "e.g. Triage new GitHub issues every morning",
    options: []
  },
  {
    id: "comfort",
    kind: "multi",
    title: "Which of these do you feel comfortable doing without AI?",
    hint: "Choose as many as you like",
    required: true,
    confirmLabel: "Submit",
    placeholder: null,
    options: [
      { id: "javascript", label: "Writing JavaScript functions" },
      { id: "sql", label: "Using SQL" },
      { id: "api-auth", label: "Configuring API authentication" },
      { id: "regex", label: "Using regex" },
      { id: "webhooks", label: "Setting up a webhook" },
      { id: "none", label: "None of the above", exclusive: true }
    ] as ReadonlyArray<SurveyOption<ComfortSkill>>
  }
]

/** Step ids in their fixed order; the machine filters conditional steps out. */
export const stepIndexById = new Map(surveySteps.map((step, index) => [step.id, index]))

export const comfortSkillIds: ReadonlyArray<ComfortSkill> = [
  "javascript",
  "sql",
  "api-auth",
  "regex",
  "webhooks",
  "none"
]

/** Seed roster until TODO(cloud-api): GET /api/agents/roster exists. Real copy, static data. */
export const seedAgentRoster: ReadonlyArray<AgentRosterEntry> = [
  {
    id: "concierge",
    name: "Concierge",
    glyph: "◆",
    oneLiner: "The agent you talk to — answers instantly and routes everything else."
  },
  {
    id: "flow-author",
    name: "Flow Author",
    glyph: "ƒ",
    oneLiner: "Writes and edits flows — TypeScript files that live in your repo."
  },
  {
    id: "run-monitor",
    name: "Run Monitor",
    glyph: "▶",
    oneLiner: "Runs flows, watches them, and reports back when they finish."
  },
  {
    id: "coder",
    name: "Coder",
    glyph: "⌘",
    oneLiner: "Implements larger changes on a branch for you to review."
  },
  {
    id: "researcher",
    name: "Researcher",
    glyph: "◎",
    oneLiner: "Digs through docs, issues, and the web and comes back with answers."
  }
]

/** Seed connectors until TODO(cloud-api): GET /api/connectors exists. */
export const seedConnectors: ReadonlyArray<ConnectorInfo> = [
  {
    id: "slack",
    name: "Slack",
    description: "Post messages, react to mentions, route alerts into channels.",
    glyph: "Sl",
    readOnly: false,
    setupFlow: "slack-setup"
  },
  {
    id: "telegram",
    name: "Telegram",
    description: "Send and receive messages through a bot.",
    glyph: "Tg",
    readOnly: false,
    setupFlow: "telegram-setup"
  },
  {
    id: "discord",
    name: "Discord",
    description: "Notify channels and respond to server events.",
    glyph: "Dc",
    readOnly: false,
    setupFlow: "discord-setup"
  },
  {
    id: "notion",
    name: "Notion",
    description: "Read and write pages and databases.",
    glyph: "No",
    readOnly: false,
    setupFlow: "notion-setup"
  },
  {
    id: "github",
    name: "GitHub",
    description: "Issues, PRs, reviews, and webhooks on your repos.",
    glyph: "Gh",
    readOnly: false,
    setupFlow: "github-setup"
  },
  {
    id: "email",
    name: "Email",
    description: "Send mail and trigger flows on inbound messages.",
    glyph: "@",
    readOnly: false,
    setupFlow: "email-setup"
  },
  {
    id: "webhooks",
    name: "Webhooks",
    description: "Receive events from anything that can POST.",
    glyph: "{}",
    readOnly: true,
    setupFlow: "webhooks-setup"
  }
]
